summary.intent: Win the Lio 'Keep the Line Running' hackathon challenge for Soony by analyzing the confidential supply-chain data drops and building a general, adaptable agent product that detects launch risks, contradictions and gaps, then acts through approvals, supplier emails and floor queries.
summary.outcome: Analyzed the archive and later drops, finding Collector's Edition shortfalls (overbooked art books, failed statues, stale pack-out log), then built a polling and versioned-store pipeline, a Launch/Today dashboard, routines UI polish, and an 'ask the site' mechanism for packing, receiving and counting. Also added approver resolution, half-done case handling and a Boise follow-up email; a Track reconciliation builder is still running.

repo: Confidential portal data lives in gitignored data/ (raw, drops, notes, img); .env holds SOONY_PORTAL_TOKEN and .env.example is committed with an empty token.
The portal API has only GET /api/v1/files, /files/{path} and /archive.zip, with no webhooks; files get replaced under the same name, so change detection must poll and compare SHA-256.
Team workflow is in CLAUDE.md and PROGRESS.md; agents claim tasks in PROGRESS.md. Entire hooks only checkpoint when repo files change.
Entire hooks fired correctly even when it looked like nothing was recorded: checkpoints are skipped when no repo files were modified.
Book stock = last count + booked receipts - backflushed consumption (packed copies x BOM); only 'Last count' is a physical measurement.
The silent-shipment check measured silence against the newest list entry rather than the clock, so a frozen tracker looked fresh.
api.py already defines a _MONEY regex further down that overrides a same-named earlier one; renamed to avoid the clash.
Paper-check costs appear only as text ('about EUR 16,800'), so routines reading numeric cost fields treated options as free until text parsing was added.
Cards marked approved hid remaining shortfalls; a 'half done' status was added when the chosen option doesn't close the gap but another would.
Routing/approver decisions must be made after final card status is known, or the rule evaluates too early.
Count page /count/<token> bypasses dashboard basic auth only for valid tokens; ASK_APP_URL must be set to the public tunnel URL or Teams/push links are relative.

code.finding: New generic site-question model (packed/received/count) with staleness thresholds via ASK_PACKOUT_STALE_HOURS, ASK_COUNT_MARGIN, ASK_COUNT_STALE_DAYS; answers stored in data/state/floor_counts.json.
Lets /count/<valid token>, /api/count/<valid token> and /assets/* through without the password; wrong or expired tokens get 404.
Added edition and part_name conditions and kind values packed/received/count; the floor channel can run in quiet mode.
Routines page reworked with repeat-suggestions, trust ladder, node-editor diagram and before/after change testing; 'Run now' for acting routines now needs confirmation.

workflow: Delegating to parallel builder subagents works if each owns separate files; shared files like api.py force a single combined commit.
Subagent screenshots use a copy of state and a separate port to avoid touching real data or sending anything.
Standing permission for small paid image-recognition calls was recorded in memory so it need not be asked again.
Confirm before outward-facing actions (supplier emails, pushes); the user explicitly approved the push of 16 commits and the Karton case returning to Today.
Do not copy the user's portal login or confidential values into docs or code.

friction: Token was empty initially, blocking the first data pull until the user supplied it.
User thought Entire hooks hadn't fired because no checkpoint appeared.
Initial analysis went stale within ~37 minutes as five new drops arrived with no notification mechanism.
Several scanned, Polish, Korean and Chinese documents required rendering to images and subagent cross-checks.
Two builders editing api.py and launch_view.py concurrently prevented clean partial commits.
The recognizer cannot read Word files, so the CPO memo remains unread.
Card ranking was wrong at first (sleeve cards above clear cases and art books) and needed several iterations.
open_items: Karton Nowak art book order (EUR 16,800, 8,000 books, valid 24 h) still unsent; needs Maren's sign-off.
Track builder (shipment truth from all sources, silence against the clock, frozen-list case) is still running and uncommitted.
Fix remaining audit points: rank cards by launch impact, separate the impacts.json writers' conflict, and make approved-but-short stay visible.
CPO memo (Word) not yet read; 'Collector's first' allocation rule isn't applied.
Register the sender email in the portal Settings; the Boise reply and supplier emails depend on it.
Set ASK_APP_URL to the public tunnel before demoing; Teams/push links break otherwise.
Backend asks from the routines builder: weekly would-handle count, per-action undo flag, server-side look-alike grouping.
Received/count answers affect Launch part gaps only, not the verifier's copies-at-risk figures.
Five site-question cards add clutter on Today; consider raising ASK_COUNT_MARGIN or ASK_COUNT_STALE_DAYS.
Earlier Claude doc duplicates the briefing page; user hasn't decided whether to delete it; briefing page and doc still show the 14:00 state.
Pitch vision-slide items: probabilistic arrival, value-weighted question agent, cross-customer network effect.
